'''Yashu-Vo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
During the time of the [[Galactic War]], Yashu-Vo was a failed [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] and became part of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Beldiss]]'s plan to take failed Mystics and teach them the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], therefore reducing the need the alliance with the Voss in favor of an army of Voss Sith. Their training was interrupted by a Republic citizen, who was invited to Beldiss to show that the failed Mystics joined him willingly. But when Yashu-Vo and her cohort considered joining the Jedi, Beldiss, unwilling to lose his disciples to the Jedi, lashed out and revealed his true colors. After the Republic hero defeated Beldiss, Yashu-Vo and the others decided to turn away from the Sith teachings. Though they were uncertain as whether the Jedi would take them in or not, the hero convinced Yashu-Vo and the other failed Mystics to go to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] where they would become [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and follow the path of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}
